Hotels.Name: Pierre and Vacances Fuerteventura Origo Mare
Hotels.ItemName: Pierre and Vacances Fuerteventura Origo Mare
Hotels.Description:
Hidden away in a quiet corner of northern Fuerteventura, this village-like resort is tailor-made for the crowd who love to hole up in the hotel for the entire holiday. It packs in everything you need – and more – for a relaxing and stress-free break, away from it all. 

The pool scene is undoubtedly the highlight here, featuring an aqua park, a children’s pool with a heated water playground, a wave pool and an adults-only pool. So, whether you’re in the mood for hurtling down water slides, a refreshing dip or just taking it easy basking in the sun, there’s an abundance of choice. 

With multiple kids’ clubs offering a wide range of fun-packed activities for little ones aged four and five all the way up to teens, there’s never a dull moment to be had here. There’s also a games room, a well-equipped gym, a mini golf course and a couple of tennis courts, guaranteeing plenty of entertainment for the whole family.

Expect plenty of choice at the buffet restaurant, or try out the à la carte restaurant for a more refined dining experience. You’ll also find a couple of bars throughout the resort, including one by the poolside, so drinks are never far away, and you can pick up any extras at the mini-market if you like. 

Keen to explore more of the surrounding area? Renting a car is the best way to get around here thanks to its away-from-it-all location. Corralejo is around 20 minutes’ drive away, and is home to plenty of bars and restaurants, some gorgeous beaches and swathes of impressive sand dunes. 

Please note that the mini golf course and tennis courts are subject to an extra charge.

Hotels.Name: KN Matas Blancas
Hotels.Description:
The stylish Kn Matas Blancas hotel makes the perfect spot for an adults-only getaway. With its close-to-the-beach location and state-of-the-art spa, this hotel is ideal for romantic breaks and wellness holidays.

Combining leisure with pleasure, there’s plenty to do at the Kn Matas Blancas. The outdoor pool has two separate areas, as well as an outdoor Jacuzzi. You can also stay active with games of squash and paddle tennis on the hotel’s courts. The exclusive spa is an ideal place to disconnect and get away from it all in an atmosphere designed for peace and relaxation.

Enjoy delicious dishes at the Verode buffet restaurant, where there’s a wide variety of dishes to choose from, as well as show cooking stations where you can watch the chefs cook up a storm. At the poolside bar, meanwhile, you can indulge in snacks and lunchtime treats – there’s even a late breakfast for those that like a lie in – all to be enjoyed at the magnificent terrace.

Hotels.Name: Occidental Jandia Mar
Hotels.Description:
The award-winning Occidental Jandía Mar is more than ready to accommodate families keen to have a relaxing and fun time. Featuring two outdoor pools, a kids’ club and playground – with a brand new water park coming in summer 2023 – the hotel will undoubtedly keep young ones happy. Have fun as a whole family with a game of mini-golf. While the kids play, adults can indulge themselves with an excellent spa experience. Book up a rejuvenating massage or chillout in the hot tub or sauna to let your everyday routine seem like a distant memory.

You’ll be located just a few minutes away from the beautiful Jandía beach on Fuerteventura’s southern coast. Get there with ease with the hotel’s shuttle service. Known for its powdery, white sand and perfect swimming conditions, be in an idyllic setting for a fun-filled family day at the beach. Adrenaline seekers will be in their element at the water park, or trying out some of the water sports activities available including surfing and diving.

If you’re more into your land sports and a keen golfer, you’ll be please to know the nearest golf course is within walking distance of the hotel.
Each evening, enjoy a meal in one of the two inhouse restaurants. Both serve up a variety of cuisines in buffet-style, enabling the whole family to build their own perfect meal. Get ready for an all-encompassing, exciting family holiday under the sunshine.

Hotels.Name: Alua Village Fuerteventura
Hotels.Description:
Located on the Jandia peninsula, from this hotel you can marvel at the panoramic views over the Atlantic, and the surrounding landscape's natural splendour. The ocean provides the backdrop for relaxing days spent by the three glistening pools – including one that's set aside for the kids – where you can chill out in the refreshing waters or bask in the sunshine on a lounger.

If you’d rather spend a day on the sand, you’ll find Butihondo Beach just moments away. Here you can surf and swim in the stunning waters. If land sports are more your style, you’ll have plenty to choose from, including tennis, volleyball and French boules. And if that sounds too fast paced, look no further than the spa centre – indulge in pampering treatments and enjoy the heated indoor pool, sauna, steam bath, and hot tub.

Feeling peckish? The hotel's international buffet restaurant takes care of mealtimes. Alternatively, treat yourself to an à la carte dinner at Mare Nubium, the Mediterranean eatery here. You'll also find a poolside snack bar for light bites and drinks during the day.

To top it off, the hotel has an entertainment programme that runs throughout the day and into the evening for your enjoyment. This includes a kids’ club to keep younger guests entertained. A great all-round hotel, you're sure to leave here feeling relaxed and rejuvenated. 

Going all out on your next holiday? Book one of the My Favorite Club rooms here! Perfect for a luxury escape, these larger rooms are the best in the house and come with a smart TV, a capsule coffee machine, plush bathrobes and slippers, and a welcome mini bar packed with soft drinks, water, and beer. And in addition to the in-room facilities, you'll get exclusive access to the Favorite Club Lounge, reserved areas in the restaurants and by the pool, and more.

Hotels.Name: Alua Suites Fuerteventura
Hotels.ItemName: Alua Suites Fuerteventura ex Suite Hotel Atlantis Fuerteventura Resort
Hotels.Description:
Stay at Alua Suites Fuerteventura, and you'll be just minutes from feeling the sand beneath your feet. A tropical oasis with mountain views, this all-inclusive Fuerteventura resort is less than 50 metres from Corralejo Beach.

This expansive complex boasts a whopping eight swimming pools, surrounded by ultra comfy loungers with thick mattresses on the sun terrace. If you get restless lying in the sun, never fear. There's a well-equipped gym and a wellness area to spend some time in, and a wide range of daytime activities for all ages to enjoy. There are also separate clubs for kids and an Adults Only My Favorite Club with two pools and an exclusive lounge reserved just for members.

Elsewhere there's a main buffet restaurant, as well as Kentia Pool Club for lunch and snacks. For an à la carte dinner, try Mare Nubium restaurant. Meanwhile, My Favorite restaurant offers both a premium buffet or à la carte set menu consisting of national and international favourites. There are also three bars including a cocktail bar and a poolside bar.

When it's finally time to hit the hay, you'll find your elegant guestroom is kitted out with a satellite flat-screen TV, air conditioning, and complimentary Wi-Fi.

Hotels.Name: Barcelo Fuerteventura Castillo
Hotels.Description:
Overlooking the sweeping sandy bay of Caleta de Fuste, this four-star resort boasts fabulous leisure facilities which will suit adults, couples and families. 

The large, attractive bungalows promise peace and privacy, and have balconies or terraces that are great for soaking up the Fuerteventura sunshine. Lined with palm trees and loungers, the four outdoor swimming pools are pretty and tranquil, with a separate area for children and fantastic views out to the ocean. An ancient castle turret stands at the end of one, a reminder of the area’s rich history. Kids will also love the splash park and mini club, with its pirate-themed adventures.

The spa is modern and well-equipped, with a focus on wellness therapies and both indoor and outdoor thermal water circuits. As well as an extensive buffet restaurant, the hotel has fine-dining international options and bars hosting evening shows and entertainment.

As well as sitting right beside lively Castillo Beach with its sunloungers and water sports, the hotel is well-placed for exploring Caleta de Fuste, a bustling resort known for its scuba diving and buzzing bars and restaurants.

An upscale home-away-from-home in beautiful Fuerteventura, the Barceló Castillo’s seaside bungalows are a brilliant place for a family break close to some of the island’s best beaches, water sports and scuba sites.

Hotels.Name: Eurostars Las Salinas
Hotels.Description:
Located just a few steps from Caleta de Fuste Beach, this stylish hotel boasts an idyllic setting and a range of top-notch facilities that the entire family will love.

An outdoor pool flanked by sun loungers is where you’ll be spending most of you time, punctuated with occasional visits to the bar for a refreshing drink. There’s a playground for the kids, too, and a tennis court if you fancy practicing your backhand in the afternoon.

Ready to take your relaxation to the next level? Head to the hotel spa for a proper pampering courtesy of a top-toe massage or other skin-tingling treatment. While there, don’t forget to visit the sauna to  melt those troubles away or immerse yourself in the warmth of the heated indoor pool. Plus, with a fully-equipped gym also on the premises, you never have to miss a workout…even while on holiday.

When hunger strikes, it’s time to visit the buffet restaurant, which specialises in a range of mouth-watering international dishes at breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Caleta de Fuste, meanwhile, is full of restaurants and bars to discover if you fancy venturing out. And if you’re into the more active side of life, Fuerteventura Golf Club is just four kilometres away while a plethora of action-packed water sports can be on found the beach just outside your front door.

Hotels.Name: Playa Park Zensation
Hotels.Description:
The Playa Park Zensation is a hotel surrounded by scenic gardens and stunning beaches on the outskirts of popular tourist area, Corralejo. Mostly known for its marvellous views of the neighbouring Canary Island of Lanzarote, this hotel is an ideal stay for those looking to split their time between relaxation and activities.

There's plenty for everyone in the family to enjoy, including a well-equipped gym, a wellness spa, yoga classes, and volleyball courts. There are four outdoor pools including an infinity pool and a children's pool, so you'll never be short of options to swim and sunbathe. 

The Smartline buffet restaurant has all your culinary desires covered with a plentiful selection of Mediterranean and international dishes on offer, while the Zensation restaurant is the place to go for a fabulous à la carte dining experience. There's a bar for every occasion, too, including a rooftop terrace bar, a poolside snack bar, a wellness bar serving healthy juices and smoothies, and a sports bar that stays open until late at night. 

With a beach less than a 10-minute walk away and good transport links in the immediate vicinity, you're in a great spot to venture out to nearby attractions and take full advantage of what the island has to offer. You'll also find find El Campanario shopping centre just 400m away. Up for an adventure? Visit Corralejo’s renowned natural park to make this holiday an unforgettable one. The hiking opportunities around here are superb, or you may prefer to rent a bike and explore the area on two wheels.

Hotels.Name: Fuerteventura Princess
Hotels.Description:
If you want to stay on the beachfront and make the most of the sea breeze and soft sands, the Fuerteventura Princess has got you covered. Set on Playa de Esquinzo, you can soak up the warm rays of sunshine with ease from here. Rooms are comfortable and stylish, and each one comes with a balcony or terrace.

Overlook the sea while dining, swing your racquet on the hotel's outdoor tennis court, or relax in the Turkish bath after a long day in the sun. The beach provides a nice setting for an early morning jog and you can always refresh in one of the on-site pools when you need to cool off. Dining options include two restaurants, five bars, and several facilities for children such as a kids’ club, games room and playground. Entertainment is provided by the hotel in the evenings.

If you’re looking for a relaxing family holiday by the beach, this could be the one for you.
